<x_0.1592><y_0.3273>As the man of fortune may perhaps enjoy by he-reditary right, or may be called by the voice of his fellow-citizens, to a feat among the legilative body of his country; he ought in his youth to be carefully infructed in the principles of her political conftitution, and of those laws by which his own rights and the rights of his fellow-citizens are determined and fecu- red.<x_0.9824><y_0.4437><class_Text>

<x_0.0166><y_0.4406>Philofophy.<x_0.1748><y_0.4617><class_Caption>

<x_0.1602><y_0.4414>Natural philosophy, as being both highly ufeful and entertaining, is well worthy of the attention of all who can afford to appropriate any part of their time to scientific purfuits; to the man of fortune, a tafte for natural philofophy might often procure the moft de-lightful entertainment. To trace the wonders of the planetary tyffems, to mark the procefs of vegetation, to examine all the properties of that fine element which we breathe, to trace the laws by which all the different elements are confined to their proper func-tions, and above all to apply the principles of natu-ral philofophy in the cultivation of the ground, are amufements which might agreeably and innocently occupy many of the leifure hours of the man who enjoys a fiplendid and independent fortune.<x_0.9834><y_0.6578><class_Text>

<x_0.1582><y_0.657>Neither do we fuppofe civil history and the prin-ciples of morals to be overlooked. Without being acquainted with thefe, how could any juft or accurate knowledge of the laws and political constitution of his country be acquired by the young gentleman? History expoefes to our observation the fortune and the actions of other human beings, and thus fupplies in fome mea-fure the place of experience; it teaches prudence, and affords exercise to the moral fenfe. When history condefcends to take notice of individuals, they are al-moft always fuch as have been eminent for virtue, for abilities, or for the rank which they held in life; to the rich and great it ought to fpeak with peculiar ef-ficacy, and they ought to be carefully invited to liften to its voice.<x_0.9844><y_0.8719><class_Text>
